title: app_checkout.v1 — an app asks Odoo (PAY1) to open a paid plan checkout
description: Sent by an app backend (Supabase edge function / Next server action) to Odoo `POST /teracorp/app/checkout`. Carries opaque references only: never a name, email, phone or address. Signed per contracts/entitlements/README.md (X-Teracorp-* headers; X-Teracorp-Event-Id = idempotency_key).

app.description: The paid app. One Odoo PAY1 payment path serves all of them (TB-D1).

app_account_ref.description: The app's opaque account id (a lowercase UUID, e.g. auth.users.id or a tenant id). Odoo stores only sha256(app:ref).

plan_code.description: A plan code configured in Odoo teracorp.app.plan, e.g. premium-30d. has_entitlement(app, plan_prefix) matches plan_code = prefix or plan_code starting with prefix || '-'.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen, unique per checkout attempt; a retry with the same key and body returns the original checkout. Also the signed X-Teracorp-Event-Id.
